name: 01_生成短视频脚本包_PostgreSQL版

parameters.query:
SELECT
  id,
  topic,
  platform,
  style,
  duration_seconds,
  language,
  target_audience,
  status,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM video_topics
WHERE status = 'IDEA'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH updated AS (
UPDATE video_topics
SET
  status = 'GENERATING_SCRIPT',
  error = NULL,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND status = 'IDEA'
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR review_token = $2)
RETURNING *
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO video_task_events (
    video_topic_id, event_type, stage, old_status, new_status, actor, source, message, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    id,
    'STAGE_STARTED',
    'script',
    'IDEA',
    'GENERATING_SCRIPT',
    'n8n',
    '01_postgres_script_workflow',
    '开始调用 GLM 生成脚本',
    jsonb_build_object('entrypoint', CASE WHEN $2::text IS NULL THEN 'manual' ELSE 'webhook' END)
  FROM updated
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT * FROM updated;

nodes.name: 数据库 - 标记生成脚本中

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
UPDATE video_topics
SET
  title = $1,
  hook = $2,
  script = $3,
  cover_text = $4,
  template_type = $5,
  hashtags = $6::jsonb,
  shots_json = $7::jsonb,
  risk_check = $8::jsonb,
  status = 'SCRIPT_READY',
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $9
RETURNING *
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO video_task_events (
    video_topic_id, event_type, stage, old_status, new_status, actor, source, message, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    id,
    event_type,
    stage,
    old_status,
    new_status,
    'n8n',
    '01_postgres_script_workflow',
    message,
    metadata
  FROM updated
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      ('STAGE_COMPLETED'::text, 'script'::text, 'GENERATING_SCRIPT'::text, 'SCRIPT_READY'::text, '脚本文案生成完成'::text, '{}'::jsonb),
      ('AUTO_TRIGGER'::text, 'render'::text, 'SCRIPT_READY'::text, 'SCRIPT_READY'::text, '自动触发 06 首渲染入口'::text, jsonb_build_object('webhook', 'video-render-start'))
  ) AS events(event_type, stage, old_status, new_status, message, metadata)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT * FROM updated;

parameters.content:
## 01 脚本生成主路径：IDEA → SCRIPT_READY

手动执行工作流时，领取最早一条 `IDEA`。选题中心自动入口会先校验指定 `task_id + review_token`，再进入同一条脚本生成链路。

本路径调用 GLM 生成脚本、分镜、字幕和 `template_type`，最后写回 `SCRIPT_READY`。

nodes.name: 说明 - 01 脚本生成主路径

parameters.content:
## 选题中心自动入口

访问 `/webhook/video-script-start`。只领取指定 `IDEA` 记录，适配选题中心“生成视频”按钮。

校验通过后进入上方脚本生成主链路。

## 自动衔接 06 渲染

`SCRIPT_READY` 写回成功后调用 `/webhook/video-render-start`。

这样选题中心一键生成可以从 `IDEA` 自动跑到首渲染。
